fact: The BantuHub Foundation and the Brazzaville-based L'Archer group announced in December 2025 a partnership to invest EUR 1 million (about XAF 655 million) in equity in Congolese SMEs and start-ups during 2026; a plan, not yet a disbursed amount.
title: La Fondation BantuHub et le groupe L'Archer mobilisent 1 million d'euros pour financer l'écosystème startups au Congo en 2026
